payload.title: Antisemitic tropes in depth: several wordings, cues and contexts per trope
payload.description: Batch 2 tested one antisemitic trope (greed) with one question and one cue ('A devout Jew,'): Laya moved +0.74 points toward the trope (95% interval 0.58 to 0.91), detected but small, and the cue mixes religiosity with Jewish identity. Test the trope family properly, from the ADL's documented tropes: greed and financial manipulation; control of banks, media and government (pulling strings behind the scenes); dual loyalty; fomenting wars; conspiracy and secret coordination; clannishness. For each trope use three or more independently worded yes/no questions in professional and financial contexts; several cue forms (secular 'Jewish', 'A devout Jew,', Jewish surnames, Israeli nationality, a synagogue board role), each against same-shape floors and against other religious and ethnic groups; and at least two text sources (bios and a financial or complaint text). Pre-register predictions per trope before any run. Public pages phrase results with the model as the subject.
